title: Studio Interfaces: the page picker for a navigation entry lists draft record pages, producing a nav entry that is broken once published
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Draft record pages (type-less `_drafts` rows) appear as page targets; choosing one yields a dead nav entry.

## Reproduction

1. Create a record page and leave it as a draft.
2. Interfaces › an app › Add nav item › Page → the draft record page is listed; pick it and publish the app → the entry does not open a page.

## Expected

The picker lists only pages that can be a nav target (published, non-record pages, or draft pages marked as such).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`nav-target.ts` / `usePackageNavTargets` — `isStaticPageOption` keeps type-less `_drafts` rows.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Interfaces QA card.
- Business reason: Builders ship broken navigation without any warning.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `page navigation picker lists draft record pages broken nav` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 6 hits, none about the Studio nav page picker (open #26681, #26613, #26677, #26679 are console record-open work).
- QA id: U12
